justification: The main shared content is only broad: both surfaces include schematic outlined/linear animal-like figures and a few simple signs such as circular or short linear marks. The biggest difference is that A is organized as a dense vertical composition with large birds/animals and patterned bands around a central pillar-like figure, while B is a loose spread of thin red line figures dominated by long boat- or crescent-like forms and scattered motifs, with no matching iconographic scheme.
